event: DOM click dispatched on the button generated by the actual UI component
render_verification: After the button event, advanced the paused preview by 34 × 16ms (near the 0.6s action peak) with manual blink held open; captured normal/wireframe/bones plus /api/bones.json. This keeps the hands at cheek level and eyes open in the final image.
method: Loaded and mounted the repository UI component web/components/actions.js in a headless DOM harness; dispatched a click on the component-generated button. The component host sent the same relative /api/action request used by web/app.js to the live C preview server.
browser_limit: This sandbox has no runnable system browser; bundled Chromium could not start because libnspr4.so and libnss3.so are absent. This records an actual component DOM event and live renderer result, not a full-page Chromium screenshot.
